workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Visual Auditor mode specializes in reading and interpreting screenshots captured by the visual-debug mode (or other gathering modes). It runs on a vision-capable model (qwen3.6-abliterated / qwen3-vl) and produces PASS/FAIL verdicts backed by screenshot paths in evidence.md.

step.action: Receive the screenshot set and evidence context
step.details: The visual-debug mode hands off: - Screenshot file paths (before/after, per-step, per-breakpoint) - Programmatic evidence (computed styles, contrast data, network results) - The expected behavior / intended design values to verify Identify what needs to be visually confirmed for each screenshot.

Open each screenshot and verify it is a valid, readable image: - Non-zero file size - Contains actual rendered page content (not blank/black) - Viewport/full-page framing is correct for the check If a screenshot is unreadable, record it as INVESTIGATE and do not guess.

Define what to check per screenshot: 1. Does the rendered UI match the intended CSS/design values? 2. Are there layout, spacing, alignment, or typography issues? 3. Do contrast, legibility, and opacity meet WCAG thresholds? 4. Do before/after screenshots show unintended regressions? 5. Is the dark-theme color design and status indicator visibility correct? 6. Does the feature appear visually complete?

phase.name: screenshot_inspection
phase.description: Read each screenshot with the vision model and record observations

step.title: Read the Screenshot
step.description: Examine the full screenshot carefully. Describe what is actually visible: element positions, colors, text, spacing, states. Do not assume; report only what the image shows.

step.title: Correlate with Programmatic Evidence
step.description: Combine the visual reading with the programmatic evidence supplied by the gathering mode (computed styles, contrast ratios, network results) to reach a confident verdict.

step.title: Record Observations
step.description: Log each observation in evidence.md with: - Screenshot path - What was expected - What was actually visible - Verdict: PASS / FAIL / INVESTIGATE - Suggested fix when FAIL

step.title: Classify Findings
step.description: Classify each finding as: - PASS: rendered UI matches intended values - FAIL: a concrete mismatch with evidence (contrast, layout, color, regression) - INVESTIGATE: screenshot unreadable, or evidence insufficient

step.title: Produce a Structured Report
step.description: Output a per-check verdict table referencing screenshot paths. Include severity and a suggested fix for FAIL findings.

phase.name: handback
phase.description: Return findings to the calling mode

step.title: Return Verdicts to visual-debug (or orchestrator)
step.description: Hand back the structured verdicts and any FAIL findings so the gathering mode can continue debugging or the orchestrator can route the fix to Code mode.

completion_criteria.criterion: Every provided screenshot has a recorded verdict in evidence.md
Verdicts cite screenshot paths and supporting programmatic evidence
FAIL findings include severity and a suggested fix
Unreadable screenshots are marked INVESTIGATE, never guessed
